02 / The headless auto-mode boundary, three steps

2.1.283 interactive (3p/telemetry off) → 2.1.284 interactive (all) → 2.1.285 headless (-p, Agent SDK)

An explicit permissions.defaultMode or --permission-mode wins at every step. The classifier itself did not move; only the unset default did. The bare-eval grader calls carry no mode, so they now run in auto mode on those environments (watch, policy unchanged). ci-sentinel passes acceptEdits and is unaffected.
